name: Moses Aquino (Moey Blanco)
statement:
My name is Moey Blanco. I am an artist based in Calgary, Canada. I paint large murals that turn everyday spaces into places people gather.

My work is built on character, pattern, and bold colour. I draw from my Filipino roots and from the neighbourhoods I paint in. Every wall starts with the people who use the space. I ask what the place means to them. Then I build the image from their answers.

Recent work includes Welcome Home Party #10, a 1,400 square foot mural on a new residential building in Calgary, an interior mural series for Congress Coffee Company, and a functional sculptural bench that tours public festivals. I have painted for city programs, festivals, and private clients across Canada and overseas.

I work well with committees. Design is a conversation. I bring options, not ultimatums. I make public art that works as hard as it plays.

NewBo City Market is a market hall, a stage, and a front door for its neighbourhood. That is exactly the kind of wall I paint.
